business.headline: AI is creating more jobs than it cuts in India. But there's a catchIndia saw 83,100 AI-related hires, compared with 31,921 layoffs and attrition linked to AI, according to a Nomura report first accessed by Bloomberg News. That means there were about 2.6 AI-related hires for every job lost or affected.
